notes.title: Let the race begin! All Stars Racing Cup to launch today
notes.notes:
Put on your racing gloves, start your engines and put the pedal to the metal to become the next All Stars racing champion!

Let the race commence and grab your copy of All Stars Racing Cup on Steam from around 8am PST, available for Windows and Mac.

British indie game development studio Ink Syntax brings you this fun, top-down arcade racing game where players can push their driving and drifting skills to the limit in this vibrant, thrilling masterpiece either alone or against up to three opponents.

With simple controls and bright, clean graphics, All Stars Racing Cup is suitable for players of all ages and is guaranteed arcade-style fun.

Additionally, Ink Syntax will donate 5% of all sales to various charities and good causes, including the British Heart Foundation, Cancer Research UK and Sheffield Children's Hospital, to name but a few.

Ink Syntax’s Managing Director and Lead Developer, Devon Chapman, commented: “We’ve had a lot of positive initial interest in our first desktop game, All Stars Racing Cup. This is fantastic news as not only do we hope to provide our fans with hours of entertainment, but it also enables us to hopefully raise a large amount to support charities and causes that really make a difference.

“So get your engines revving and head over to Steam and purchase your copy today!”

All Stars Racing Cup will be available to download today on Steam for just $7.99 (£5.82 GBP).

notes.title: Sharing the love
notes.notes:
As briefly mentioned in the game description, from our launch date onwards we are pleased to confirm that we will be donating 5% of the proceeds from every game sold to charities and local causes including the British Heart Foundation, Cancer Research UK and Sheffield Children's Hospital, and also to local schools for equipment and software to teach pupils to learn coding skills; among many other good causes.

Thanks for reading!
Ink Syntax

notes.title: Are we nearly there yet?
notes.notes:
...Short answer, yes! 

We are pleased to announce that our new game, All Stars Racing Cup, is now officially "coming soon" on Steam, and is ready to launch within the next few weeks! 

Our expected launch date is Thursday 1st February and at this time we don't expect any delays.

The price of the game will be just $7.99 (roughly £5.82 GBP) to make it accessible and affordable for all.

We hope you'll love the game and thanks for stopping by!

Ink Syntax
